- Provide a short copy of your IRP relevant to API/key exposures (redacted where appropriate).
- Share the SIG/CAIQ mapping or SOC2 artifacts that show logging, access controls, and retention for customer API telemetry.

We’ve started a ticket on our side (HubSpot ID REDWOOD-HT-4821) and uploaded an initial telemetry snapshot and request traces to the folder below (sensitive; share only on secure channels):
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Finora-IR-Uploads

Attachments: finora-telemetry-snapshot-2027-10-01.csv (sample, 10MB), preliminary indicators list.

We’d like to schedule a 30‑minute sync today or tomorrow for a quick coordination call and to agree on handoff for evidence and postmortem schedule. Our proposed times: 2027-10-01 20:00 UTC or 2027-10-02 14:00 UTC.

Thanks — Alex Turner (Finora Security)
